regime_context: Hong Kong shows a narrow rotation (4 of 17 themes eligible) with Banks (H + HK) as the clear leader and Energy (H-shares) as the sole challenger (margin 0.33). The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so eligibility itself is the one trustworthy leg; cross-sectional rank is a focus lens only. Most themes are ineligible, and nearly all are unscorable (no ETF proxy), which truncates the gradeable call set.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) overtakes Banks (H + HK) as the rotation leader by score while BOTH remain trend-gate eligible — that would be a confirmed, checkable leadership handoff; retire the watch if Banks regains a margin above 0.5 and Energy's durability_bar falls below 0.6.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed leader by rank, durability (bar 0.67), and breadth (0.692), and are trend-gate eligible. Momentum rank is not alpha, but with the validated absolute-trend gate the staying-power leg argues for maintaining exposure while the theme remains eligible. Crowding_z 0.93 is below the crowded threshold, so no size-down caution fires.
theses.dissent: HK banks face structural asset-quality and regulatory pressure; the momentum rank is not a return forecast, and a narrow rotation (4/17 eligible) with absorption 0.46 signals weak conviction behind the leadership — the lead could be recent flow concentration rather than durable alpha.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) theme drops out of trend-gate eligibility (eligible flips to false) before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only challenger with a trend-tagged Hurst (hurst_tag=trend) and the strongest durability bar (0.76) plus highest breadth (0.8) in the ranks, and it is eligible. The gap to Banks is modest (margin 0.33). This is not a call on Banks handing off — just an independent trend-eligible, broad theme worth keeping exposure to.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend (only trend-tagged eligible theme besides Banks' mixed)
theses.dissent: Commodity-linked H-share energy names can mean-revert quickly on a China demand or oil-price fade; the rank is display-only and score 0.983 is already well below Banks, so this could just be the first stop of a weakening tape.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) drops below durability_bar 0.5 or loses trend-gate eligibility before the check-by date

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the only scorable theme in the entire table (ETF proxy 3033.HK) and sits at rank 13 with a negative score (-0.792), ineligible via the trend gate, and tagged mean-revert. The one validated leg — the absolute-trend gate — says this theme has already broken its trend and is in shake-out risk territory. Lean is to avoid rather than fade (do-not-fade guardrail; weakness can persist without a short edge).
evidence: crowding_z -0.83, crowded=false (no reflexivity concern, but no buy trigger either)
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag means a sharp snap-back is possible; an unscheduled macro surprise (unscheduled_share 0.75) could reverse the negative flow, and the avoid lean forfeits any rebound.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK closes back above its own trailing trend-gate threshold and China Tech & Internet flips to eligible=true before the check-by date
